title: Upside Down gravity
description: This datapack makes all mobs named "Dinnerbone" float upwards, like there gravity got flipped
body:
This datapack changes how gravity works in minecraft (sorta). When you name a mob "Dinnerbone", usually, It just flips upside down. But i thought, "That's not realistic!" So, I did a bit of coding, and made [this](https://modrinth.com/datapack/upside-down-gravity) datapack, which basically flips their gravity as well!
<details>
<summary>WARNING</summary>

If you have any mobs already named "Dinnerbone" and you install this pack, their gravity WILL be flipped. Make sure to change their name or leash them. Cause the floating speed is the terminal falling speed(78.4b\s).

</details>
